reviews.text: Thank you for taking the time to leave us a review and for trusting us with your pet's care!
Very helpful and caring doctors and staff. Very nice facility using.
I took my rabbit in for a yearly check up. Staff and vet are always amazing and kind. We won't go anywhere else.
very experienced vet .. highly recommend them doctors and staff are awesome

We brought our rescue cat, Rocket, to Gulf Coast Veterinary Specialists after dealing with ongoing stomach and digestive issues and not really knowing what was going on. As pet owners, that uncertainty can be extremely stressful, and I’m so grateful for the way everyone here treated both Rocket and us.

A huge shoutout to Jenah and Dr. Puchot. They were incredibly kind, patient, thorough, and compassionate. They took the time to listen to everything Rocket had been through, explain what they were looking for, go over our options, and answer all of our questions without ever making us feel rushed. You could genuinely tell they cared about him and wanted to get to the bottom of what was happening.

I also want to recognize the front desk, pharmacy staff, nurses, technicians, and everyone else we interacted with. Every single person was welcoming, professional, helpful, and kind. From checking in, to his care, to getting his medications, the entire experience was handled so smoothly.

Rocket has already been through a lot since we rescued him, so finding a team that made us feel like he was truly in good hands meant more than I can explain. It’s obvious that the people here don’t just do this as a job — they genuinely care about the animals they treat.

Thank you to Dr. Puchot, Jenah, and the entire Gulf Coast Veterinary Specialists team for taking such good care of our little guy. We are extremely grateful and would absolutely recommend them to anyone needing specialty care for their pet.

This review is addressing the Specialist service side of the business, not the Emergency services.This facility is absolutely top notch in equipment and personnel. They have all the resources available to help your pet. The reason this isn't a 5 star review is that from a clinic culture standpoint they are a big machine built to process your pet. What do I mean? As a team, they really don't care. I'm not staying individual people are bad, it's just that the entire place is like an factory for processing your pet's condition. Vast numbers of people handing vast numbers of pets is not conducive to a careful, caring environment. Case in point. Some time ago we had a pet diagnosed with a terminal condition that could be alleviated (not cured) with regular treatments. Our only interaction with the Specialist for this condition was a single phone call before starting treatment. We never met them in person and never spoke to them again. We even eventually figured out it was the Techs under this vet who were answering emails sent to them. In addition, we would ask techs questions to which we received very confident wrong answers. We would also receive different answers from different techs regarding our pet's status and treatments as we were undergoing the regimen. And the icing on the cake was when our animal died. We used an in home pet hospice service who euthanized our little girl at home. Since that hospice service coordinates and communicates with our other vets, they made notification. From our long time regular vet we received a phone call and a card, from a specialist at a different clinic that was previously treating a minor issue we received a card and from the hospice we received a card and flowers. From Gulf Coast...we got a call 2 weeks later reminding us of our next appointment. Just heartless.

I'm not saying don't go there, just understand that it's a machine that does not care, so ask all the questions, make sure you understand and demand answers if you are not getting the info or service you think you should. Keep your regular vet well in the loop. We got better, more accurate communication from our own vet by forwarding reports from Gulf Coast than Gulf Coat ever gave us themselves.

Excellent. First time visit and was immediately impressed by the courteous, friendly, professional and well-trained staff. Great customer service and a very inviting atmosphere!  Felt very good leaving our cat there for her diagnostic tests knowing she was in good hands.
Absolutely a fantastic place to go when needed!  PA and doctor were very caring, compassionate and thorough!  They listened and understood our issues very well!  My fur baby had excellent care there!
Great Place,Great Doctors , a little pricey for retirees.😊 …
Amazing place.  Staff wants to be there.  Doctors are great.  Got my holland lop in for emergency dental work the next day.   Saved my girl lots of pain.  Thank you so much!
We always receive the best care at Gulf Coast veterinary services. We have visited the dermatology team and the internal medicine. The entire staff is always friendly, welcoming and caring.
Our cat had signs of abuse when they left the facility. It was obvious that care was not taken when shaving areas that needed to be looked at and he has multiple puncture wounds on his paws.
Amazing! The support staff, the triage nurses, the veterinarians and pharmacists were so efficient, compassionate, competent and thorough.  Highly recommend this facility.

Dr Douglas worked us in to examine an injured eye on my pup Bella she and her assistant were very gentle, thorough and spent time explaining the injury and treatment. Couldnt have been happier driving 250 mikes and fighting houston traffic to receive this level of expertise
H mcgee

This place is overpriced and they are overcharging for services. I read the negative reviews and moved accordingly. It saved me over 4k in unnecessary bills.

Thank goodness that I found a place that was able to perform what my pet needed at a fraction of the price. Thank you to google reviews and the people for their honest opinions.

I gave this place two stars because the front desk staff were very friendly.

I would highly recommend this hospital. They took really good care of our bunny in emergency. Front office service was good.

Dr . Lopez was really nice in taking care of our bunny and explaining to us patiently what was wrong with him and then the medications and other details.
Great exceptional  service.
Dr Whitney was absolutely amazing! He took the time to thoroughly explain every detail and was so personable! HIGHLY recommend! Can’t say enough wonderful comments about him. Thank you Dr Whitney
Dr. Canning and staff are excellent! They take time to explain everything in detail, such a pleasant experience…
Gulf coast took care of my baby Oliver, several times.  I especially loved the photos shared while treatment was being had. I will miss my baby.
Excellent, empathetic and attentive service, especially for 9pm on a Saturday night!!  Highly  recommend GCVS!

Very disappointed in GCVS , brought my deaf dog to be tested and were given a partial wave length graft report , and we paid full price and now GCVS wants to put my dog under again because there machine failed , we are not putting our dog under again because it’s too hard on her , we’re trying to get a full report to submit to the courts to physically prove our dog is deaf a letter doesn’t hold up with the breed and the courts, need to be the actual wave signal graft report , please help us get this report or reimbursed due to incomplete test
The reasonable waiting time, good explanation of the issues with pets and Proposed tests.

My experience with GCVS was amazing! My dog was referred there by a different emergency hospital, after telling me he had a 50/50 shot at survival. The Vets at GCVS never once made that claim, they were positive and expected my baby to make a full recovery and he did! I was also very pleased, that after a two and a half day hospital stay, the price was not near as high as the previous vet told me to expect.

I called at 12:45am.spoke to pricella(hope I spelled her name correct),she was awsum.she stayed in touch with dr.'s and myself til almost or right at 4am.she and dr.'s resolved my cat Daisys problem(too long for details).I am so grateful for gcvs.Daisy has been going there since like feb.2022 and she and I have always been happy campers.😸👍💖
The Dr’s and staff are always compassionate and gentle either my dog. We came for an emergency and my pup had a surgery here in the past. Have always had a good experience.  Thank you

brought my bird cockatiel in to get checked and they suggested an xray and fluids which would help but ended up giving my bird back in the worst condition than i brought her in (they said they didn’t even give her anything)and when she died in my hands in the room i told them she had passed and tried correcting me saying “no she still has a heart beat” but when they checked she said yeah she’s gone. like yea i just told you and proceeded to charge me for the check up with my birdie gone.

Excellent experience with dermatology department.  Cleared up all skin issues with our bulldog. It was actually less expensive than our regular veterinary and the results were much better.  Highly recommend
We’re happy to hear you had a positive experience and appreciate you allowing us to care for your pet. Thank you for the great feedback!

I had an exceptional experience at the veterinary clinic. The front desk, Dr. Kerr, and Alyssa provided outstanding service, care, and professionalism. Dr. Kerr performed a TPLO surgery on both my dog’s knees, and she did an incredible job. Chance and I are incredibly grateful for the excellent care he received.
Dr Jarden is amazing.  He is very thorough, patient and answered all of my questions.  The most important is that my dog likes him too.

The team at GCVS genuinely cared for my fur baby. The team was empathetic to my family and gentle to my sweet boy. They were helpful and very understanding that the financial burden of treating him would be very hard and they even made compromises to provide the best care that I could afford.

My visit to the ER involved a physician who provided no treatment, leaving my dog to endure both nurse and spinal cord pain; the staff seemed highly unprofessional. You might consider the chance that your children could enter the ER and be left aside to suffer. No pain reliever was given. What is the ER for? People may wait until morning for regular visits rather than using ER services, which charge a premium price for unprofessional care.

The staff here is outstanding and welcoming,  from the front desk associates to vet assistants to the veterinary staff.    Can't say enough thanks to these super heroes 👏💯  Thanks so much for your wonderful care, Dr. Jardes! …

From arrival, the level of care, compassion and concern was top notch. The communication was great and it is clearly an emergency center and organization run like a tight ship. We found the vet herself to be extremely knowledgeable and willing to take time to explain all options in detail. The diagnosis was spot on and our fur baby is in advanced stages of recovery now. We would return if necessary (God forbid) and recommend to anyone. Thank you GCVS! You get 4 paws up!

Updating with additional thanks for a caring so well for a different hedgehog that needed a spay. Very thankful for Dr Magnotti.

From reception (where I received a hug) to the exotics team (vet techs and docs) GCVS has helped me care for all my hedgies. I truly appreciate them!
Brought my puppy in who got bit by a copperhead. GCVS got him in promptly and kept me updated. The whole staff is kind and compassionate

My experience was not great.  While the front office staff was warm and welcoming, the doctor was not.  Her approach was more to shame the pet parent rather than address the health concerns of why I brought my pet in, in the first place.  Due to her lack of grace or kindness, her recommendations were not considered and caused us to seek medical attention for our pet elsewhere. She was not professional but rather punitive, moralistic and hypercritical.  She inflicted emotional discomfort and focused on “teaching a lesson” rather than focusing on objective facts, constructive feedback or finding a solution that was help my pet.  She targeted my character by repeating herself over and over with the problem rather than explaining how she would help.  Since she focused on targeting my character, I was discouraged to continue treatment and find help elsewhere.
